name: regulationsgov-mcp
description: Enables interaction with the Regulations.gov API to search federal rulemaking dockets, proposed and final rules, public comments, and comment periods. Supports tracking FAR/DFARS case histories and monitoring open comment periods across federal agencies with optional API key authentication for higher rate limits.
